callouts.label: Wind-Down Signals
callouts.hint: The quiet bedroom at upper left with dim light and a settled child.
callouts.description: A predictable wind-down helps the brain and body shift toward sleep.
callouts.tip: Gentle routines work best when they fit the family and child.

callouts.label: Consistent Timing
callouts.hint: The large moon-faced clock with hands and no numerals.
callouts.description: Similar sleep and wake timing helps the body organize its daily rhythm.
callouts.tip: Perfection is not required; patterns can be adjusted gradually.

callouts.label: Memory Sorting
callouts.hint: The glowing brain library filled with picture cards.
callouts.description: During sleep, the brain organizes and strengthens learning and memories.
callouts.tip: Sleep supports practice; it does not replace studying or experience.

callouts.label: Emotion Reset
callouts.hint: The control room between storm clouds and clearing sky.
callouts.description: Sleep helps emotion systems recover and improves the ability to pause before reacting.
callouts.tip: Poor sleep can make ordinary challenges feel harder.

callouts.label: Growth and Repair
callouts.hint: The golden growing figure under careful workshop lights.
callouts.description: Sleep supports growth signals and tissue repair in a growing body.
callouts.tip: Growth happens across time, not in one single night.

callouts.label: Immune Support
callouts.hint: The bright shield workshop in the lower-left room.
callouts.description: Sleep supports immune defenses that help the body respond to illness.
callouts.tip: Sleep is one support, alongside hygiene, food, movement, and healthcare.

callouts.label: Energy Recharge
callouts.hint: The glowing blue energy chamber in the lower middle-left.
callouts.description: Rest restores alertness and physical energy for the next day.
callouts.tip: Morning fatigue can be a useful clue to review sleep routines.

callouts.label: Temperature Rhythm
callouts.hint: The cool blue chamber with a snowflake-like symbol.
callouts.description: Body temperature naturally shifts as part of the sleep-wake rhythm.
callouts.tip: A comfortable environment can make sleep easier.

callouts.label: Morning Attention
callouts.hint: The operator restoring bright stars in the lower middle-right.
callouts.description: Adequate sleep supports attention, decision-making, and learning.
callouts.tip: Sleepy brains may miss details or react more slowly.

callouts.label: Sleep Environment
callouts.hint: The calm sunrise bedroom at lower right.
callouts.description: A safe, quiet, comfortable sleep space supports rest.
callouts.tip: Families can reduce light, noise, or device interruptions in ways that fit their home.
